title: Decoupled SEO synchronization and commerce isolation
summary: Prepared a standalone trigger-free SEO migration, durable reconciliation queue, background worker and admin synchronization status. Local validation pending; no production changes.

changes.detail: Standalone replacement SQL with no commerce triggers, queue leases, idempotent completion, exponential retries, failure status and scheduled worker.
Admin dashboard reports synchronization health, pending jobs and sanitized failures; existing AI draft workflow remains separate from commerce.
Storefront falls back to current catalogue facts when stored metadata is stale. Original migration and all prior work preserved.

validation.name: Local checks
validation.detail: SQL failure injection, existing checkout tests, TypeScript, lint and Node 24 build pending. No hosted migration, deployment or payment test performed.
